tree.heading: Records and reports
tree.text: A person who is required to carry out the objectives of this chapter, including— shall establish and maintain such records and report such information as the Administrator may by regulation reasonably require to carry out the objectives of this chapter.

children.text: an authorized agent of a person described in paragraph (1), (2), or (3),

tree.heading: Access and copying
tree.text: The Administrator or the Administrator’s authorized representative, on presentation of credentials of the Administrator, may at reasonable times have access to and copy any records required to be maintained under subsection (a).

tree.heading: Confidentiality
tree.text: The Administrator shall maintain the confidentiality of documents and records that contain proprietary information.
